scheme_name: Scheme for Grant of Pension Benefits to Journalists
other_conditions: Must be a citizen of India
Must be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry by birth or by continuous residence for at least ten years
Must not be receiving any pension or honorarium from the Central or State Government
In case of chronic ill‑health or permanent incapacitation, applicants with at least ten years of service are eligible irrespective of age
In the event of the journalist's death, the spouse is eligible for 50% of the pension
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of ₹6,000 payable on the 10th of each month.
